description: Activate when the user provides reviewer or co-author feedback (annotated PDF, pasted comments, or reviewer report) and wants to implement revisions. Extracts review points, maps them to paper.tex locations, classifies actions, implements changes, recompiles, and generates a change log + latexdiff. Handles the full revision loop from feedback to committed changes.
